text:
Riverdale Family Health Team (fictional)
Appointment reminder
Patient: Fatima Al-Sayed
Your appointment with Dr. Patel is on Monday, September 21, 2026 at 3:15 p.m.
Please arrive 10 minutes early and bring your Ontario health card. If you need to cancel, call (416) 555-0120 at least 24 hours before your appointment.
